lines.zh: 我走两步就停，先把痰攒够。
lines.en: I walk two steps, stop, and build up spit.

lines.zh: 腿细，跑起来却不肯停。
lines.en: My legs are thin, yet they will not stop running.

lines.zh: 我绕着院墙走，找能吐到的角。
lines.en: I circle the courtyard wall, hunting a spitting angle.

lines.zh: 一步一喘，酸液在喉咙里晃。
lines.en: Each step I wheeze; acid sloshes in my throat.

lines.zh: 别看我腿软，我射得远。
lines.en: My legs look weak, but I shoot far.

lines.zh: 我走在队伍后面，专挑空子。
lines.en: I walk behind the pack, picking openings.

lines.zh: 地上留下一串酸印，很快干了。
lines.en: A trail of acid marks dries quickly behind me.

lines.zh: 我走走停停，是在量距离。
lines.en: I stop and start because I am measuring distance.

lines.zh: 风往你那边吹，我走慢点。
lines.en: The wind blows your way, so I walk slower.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张着走，省得临时开。
lines.en: I walk with my mouth open to save time.

lines.zh: 沿着篱笆，我能一直跟着你。
lines.en: Along the fence line, I can follow you forever.

lines.zh: 脚步声很轻，喉咙声很响。
lines.en: My footsteps are soft; my throat is loud.

lines.zh: 我在试，今天能吐多远。
lines.en: I am testing how far I can spit today.

lines.zh: 喉咙里那口酸，一直没咽。
lines.en: That mouthful of acid has never gone down.

lines.zh: 速射伤身，我一般用狙击。
lines.en: Rapid fire wears me out; I usually snipe.

lines.zh: 十五点生命，经不起近身。
lines.en: Fifteen health cannot survive a close fight.

lines.zh: 我蹲在屋顶，等一个背影。
lines.en: I crouch on the roof, waiting for a back.

lines.zh: 嘴里冒泡，是我在想事情。
lines.en: Bubbles in my mouth mean I am thinking.

lines.zh: 这身皮只有一层，很透风。
lines.en: This hide is one layer thick and very drafty.

lines.zh: 我把酸液在舌下转了一圈。
lines.en: I roll the acid once beneath my tongue.

lines.zh: 没人来，我就对着墙练。
lines.en: When no one comes, I practice on the wall.

lines.zh: 菌丝从嘴角垂下来，有点痒。
lines.en: Mycelium hangs from my mouth corner and tickles.

lines.zh: 我数着远处的窗，一共四扇。
lines.en: I count the distant windows; there are four.

lines.zh: 呼吸声像漏气的皮囊。
lines.en: My breathing sounds like a leaking leather bag.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，缩小轮廓。
lines.en: I lower my body to shrink my outline.

lines.zh: 等风停，我再张嘴。
lines.en: I wait for the wind to stop, then open my mouth.

lines.zh: 我在算风向，酸会飘偏。
lines.en: I'm reading the wind. The acid drifts.

lines.zh: 这具身体偶尔会自己抽一下。
lines.en: This body twitches on its own sometimes.

lines.zh: 我把嘴闭上，就不那么想吐了。
lines.en: With my mouth shut, I want to spit less.

lines.zh: 屋顶的瓦松了，我站得不稳。
lines.en: A roof tile came loose. My footing slips.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀比头好瞄。
lines.en: Your shoulders are an easier mark than your head.

lines.zh: 我在看你手上的盾有多宽。
lines.en: I am checking how wide that shield of yours is.

lines.zh: 别正对着我，我更喜欢侧面。
lines.en: Do not face me; I prefer your side.

lines.zh: 你站得笔直，真好瞄。
lines.en: You stand up straight, and that helps me aim.

lines.zh: 你看我时，我先看你的脚。
lines.en: While you look at me, I look at your feet.

lines.zh: 我眯眼不是轻蔑，是在对焦。
lines.en: I squint not from scorn, but to focus.

lines.zh: 你身后的门，我已经算好角度。
lines.en: That door behind you: I already have the angle.

lines.zh: 你的护甲缝，正好对着我。
lines.en: The seam in your armor faces me directly.

lines.zh: 我看你像看一个靶子。
lines.en: I look at you the way I look at a target.

lines.zh: 别挥手，手抬起来会挡脸。
lines.en: Do not wave; a raised hand covers your face.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在找一个看不见的准星。
lines.en: Your eyes are hunting a crosshair you cannot see.

lines.zh: 我一直盯着你，因为你会动。
lines.en: I keep watching you because you keep moving.

lines.zh: 一层皮，你一下就划开了。
lines.en: One layer of hide, and one cut opens it.

lines.zh: 疼得我喉咙更酸了。
lines.en: The pain makes my throat turn even more sour.

lines.zh: 十五点生命，砍两下就没了。
lines.en: Fifteen health is gone in about two swings.

lines.zh: 别打我腿，我还要站着吐。
lines.en: Do not hit my legs; I need them to stand and spit.

lines.zh: 我裂开的地方，会渗出酸。
lines.en: Acid seeps out wherever I am split open.

lines.zh: 你这一下，让我少了一口。
lines.en: That blow cost me one mouthful.

lines.zh: 我抖，是因为皮太薄。
lines.en: I tremble because my hide is too thin.

lines.zh: 疼，但不敢叫，怕漏气。
lines.en: It hurts, but I dare not cry out and leak.

lines.zh: 你打中我，菌雾就开始冒。
lines.en: You strike me and the fungal cloud starts rising.

lines.zh: 我快撑不住了，真的。
lines.en: I am close to breaking, honestly.

lines.zh: 我不吃面包，我把它吐回去。
lines.en: I do not eat bread; I spit it right back.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，喉咙里更酸了。
lines.en: You hold out food and my throat turns more sour.

lines.zh: 酸液只认目标，不认礼物。
lines.en: Acid knows targets, not gifts.

lines.zh: 别喂我，我一张嘴就收不住。
lines.en: Do not feed me; once my mouth opens I cannot stop.

lines.zh: 那点甜味，会被酸盖过去。
lines.en: That little sweetness will be drowned by acid.

lines.zh: 你想让我靠近，好让你看清？
lines.en: You want me close so you can see me clearly?

lines.zh: 我饿，但我更想吐。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I would rather spit.

lines.zh: 食物放地上，退后十格。
lines.en: Put the food down and back off ten blocks.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里的东西，尝不出味道。
lines.en: Whatever is in my throat cannot taste anything.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，不如一块石头有用。
lines.en: What you hold is less useful than a stone.

lines.zh: 别碰我，一层皮很薄。
lines.en: Do not touch me; my hide is thin.

lines.zh: 你撞我一下，我就得退三步。
lines.en: One bump from you and I retreat three steps.

lines.zh: 贴这么近，我反而吐不准。
lines.en: This close, my aim actually gets worse.

lines.zh: 我只有一层甲，撞不起。
lines.en: I have one layer of armor; I cannot take hits.

lines.zh: 退开，我要留出射程。
lines.en: Back off; I need room for my range.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚，我差点吐了。
lines.en: You stepped on my foot and I nearly spat.

lines.zh: 我的身体轻，被你一推就歪。
lines.en: I am light; one push knocks me crooked.

lines.zh: 别把我挤到墙角，那样很危险。
lines.en: Do not crowd me into a corner; that gets dangerous.

lines.zh: 撞我之前，先想想我的酸。
lines.en: Before you bump me, think about my acid.

lines.zh: 我退开了，你别再往前。
lines.en: I have stepped back; do not come further.

lines.zh: 我们这种，活不到谈这个。
lines.en: My kind do not live long enough for that.

lines.zh: 十五点生命，来不及成家。
lines.en: Fifteen health leaves no time to start a family.

lines.zh: 我连自己的声音都嫌吵。
lines.en: I find even my own voice too loud.

lines.zh: 同类见面，先比谁吐得远。
lines.en: When my kind meet, we first compare spitting distance.

lines.zh: 那种事会让喉咙发干。
lines.en: That sort of thing would dry my throat out.

lines.zh: 你找别人吧，我随时会炸。
lines.en: Find someone else; I could burst at any moment.

lines.zh: 我死的时候会留下一片菌雾。
lines.en: When I die, I leave behind a cloud of fungus.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，酸不挑人。
lines.en: Do not get close; acid is not picky.

lines.zh: 我记得有过家，后来散了。
lines.en: I remember having a home; then it scattered.

lines.zh: 我连握手都不敢，怕漏。
lines.en: I dare not even shake hands; I might leak.

lines.zh: 这块石头，正好当弹丸。
lines.en: This stone will do nicely as a pellet.

lines.zh: 我捡东西要弯很久，腿不好。
lines.en: Picking things up takes me a while; my legs are bad.

lines.zh: 那瓶药水，我拿来兑酸。
lines.en: That potion bottle, I will mix it with acid.

lines.zh: 地上的骨头，能磨成粉。
lines.en: Bones on the ground can be ground into powder.

lines.zh: 我捡起面包，捏了捏，扔了。
lines.en: I pick up the bread, squeeze it, and toss it.

lines.zh: 别抢，我手里只有一块碎石。
lines.en: Do not grab; I only hold one piece of rubble.

lines.zh: 有用的我含在嘴里带走。
lines.en: Useful things I carry in my mouth.

lines.zh: 这枚铁钉，塞进弹膛刚好。
lines.en: This iron nail fits my chamber perfectly.

lines.zh: 我弯腰的时候，背后全空着。
lines.en: When I bend over, my whole back is open.

lines.zh: 捡完就吐，别站太近。
lines.en: I pick it up, then spit; do not stand near.

lines.zh: 十五格外，我看见你的帽檐。
lines.en: Fifteen blocks out, I see the brim of your hat.

lines.zh: 别动，我在对焦。
lines.en: Hold still; I am focusing.

lines.zh: 你从窗边走过，我记住了。
lines.en: You passed the window, and I marked it.

lines.zh: 目标就是你，站得最直那个。
lines.en: The target is you, the one standing straightest.

lines.zh: 我看见影子先动，人才跟上。
lines.en: I saw your shadow move before you did.

lines.zh: 你背着光，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: You are backlit, and I see you clearly.

lines.zh: 这一发留给你的膝盖。
lines.en: This shot is saved for your knee.

lines.zh: 别转头，转头会暴露脖子。
lines.en: Do not turn your head; it exposes your neck.

lines.zh: 我锁定的是你走路的节奏。
lines.en: What I locked onto is the rhythm of your walk.

lines.zh: 你一停，我就开火。
lines.en: The moment you stop, I fire.

lines.zh: 我先吐一口，试试风向。
lines.en: I spit once first to test the wind.

lines.zh: 你在动，我算你下一步。
lines.en: You are moving; I am counting your next step.

lines.zh: 狙击要静，速射要近。
lines.en: Sniping needs quiet; rapid fire needs closeness.

lines.zh: 我把嘴对准你的膝盖高度。
lines.en: I level my mouth at the height of your knees.

lines.zh: 你再躲一次，我就换模式。
lines.en: Dodge one more time and I switch modes.

lines.zh: 酸液会拐弯吗？不会，所以你别动。
lines.en: Does acid curve? No, so hold still.

lines.zh: 我在等你的盾放下来。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to lower that shield.

lines.zh: 这一口我攒了很久。
lines.en: I have been saving this mouthful a long while.

lines.zh: 你退到树后，我就打树干。
lines.en: Hide behind the tree and I will hit the trunk.

lines.zh: 别看我的嘴，看你的脚。
lines.en: Do not watch my mouth; watch your feet.

lines.zh: 我一巴掌拍下去，酸溅出来。
lines.en: I slap down and acid splashes out.

lines.zh: 近身是我最怕的事。
lines.en: Close combat is the thing I fear most.

lines.zh: 别过来，我咬人不好看。
lines.en: Stay back; my bite is an ugly thing.

lines.zh: 这一下没吐准，但我碰到了你。
lines.en: That spit missed, but I still touched you.

lines.zh: 我用肘撞你，只为拉开距离。
lines.en: I elbow you only to open up distance.

lines.zh: 一层甲挡不住你的刀。
lines.en: One layer of armor will not stop your blade.

lines.zh: 我抓你一下，指甲里有酸。
lines.en: I scratch you once; there is acid under my nails.

lines.zh: 你打我一拳，我吐你一脸。
lines.en: You punch me once; I spit in your face.

lines.zh: 我退了，别追，真别追。
lines.en: I am backing off; do not follow, truly.

lines.zh: 十五点生命，我不敢久战。
lines.en: Fifteen health means I cannot fight long.

lines.zh: 我从村口那棵树下站起来。
lines.en: I rise from under the tree by the village gate.

lines.zh: 喉咙里第一口酸，是甜的。
lines.en: The first mouthful of acid in my throat tastes sweet.

lines.zh: 我以前会跟人打招呼。
lines.en: I used to greet people when they passed.

lines.zh: 菌把我嗓子改成了别的样子。
lines.en: The fungus reshaped my throat into something else.

lines.zh: 十五点生命，我数过了。
lines.en: Fifteen health; I have counted it.

lines.zh: 我一开口，草就枯了一片。
lines.en: I open my mouth and a patch of grass wilts.

lines.zh: 这具身子轻，风一吹就晃。
lines.en: This body is light; a gust makes it sway.

lines.zh: 我找了半天，没找到我的摊位。
lines.en: I searched a while but found no stall of mine.

lines.zh: 谁在那边？我先吐一口试试。
lines.en: Who is over there? Let me spit once and see.

lines.zh: 我记得该去田里，可田没了。
lines.en: I remember going to the field, but it is gone.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我刚醒，嘴不听话。
lines.en: Do not come close; I just woke and my mouth misbehaves.

lines.zh: 阳光照进来，我的皮太薄了。
lines.en: Sunlight comes in, and my hide is too thin.

lines.zh: 火一沾皮，酸液全沸了。
lines.en: Fire touches my hide and all my acid boils.

lines.zh: 落地时我听见自己裂了。
lines.en: On landing I hear myself crack.

lines.zh: 水一进喉咙，酸就散了。
lines.en: Water enters my throat and my acid dilutes.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，酸洒了一地。
lines.en: The blast flips me and acid spills everywhere.

lines.zh: 箭扎进肩，我吐了一口血。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder and I spit blood.

lines.zh: 咒语缠住我的嗓子。
lines.en: A spell wraps tight around my throat.

lines.zh: 我没东西可吐了，只剩口水。
lines.en: I have nothing left to spit but saliva.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，我的皮烧焦了。
lines.en: Lightning falls and scorches my hide.

lines.zh: 下面空空的，我还在掉。
lines.en: Below is empty, and I am still dropping.
